languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Destroy robots: their wreckage becomes climbable scrap.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Destrueix robots: les seves restes es converteixen en ferralla escalable.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>A very uneven heap occasionally attracts a bulky junk drop.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Una pila molt desnivellada atrau ocasionalment una gran càrrega de ferralla.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<green>Build and climb onto settled scrap at %1 m.</green>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<green>Construeix i puja sobre ferralla assentada a %1 m.</green>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<green>Scrap</green>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<green>Ferralla</green>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Target</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Objectiu</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua>Wave</aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua>Onada</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Incoming junk! It will settle into a low part of the heap.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Arriba ferralla! S'assentarà en una zona baixa de la pila.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<green><bold>The team reached %1 m!</bold></green>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<green><bold>L'equip ha arribat als %1 m!</bold></green>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua>Your Taser chains electricity, recharges slowly, and improves with supply cores.</aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua>El teu Taser encadena electricitat, es recarrega lentament i millora amb nuclis de subministrament.</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<yellow>Clear each wave: fires go out and personal equipment and scaffolding fall at the center.</yellow>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<yellow>Supera cada onada: el foc s'apaga i al centre cauen equipament personal i bastides.</yellow>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Later waves unlock new chassis. Cutters carry stonecutters and tear down scaffolds; Ghasts throw iron blocks and release lots of scrap.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Les onades posteriors desbloquegen nous xassissos. Els talladors destrueixen bastides; els Ghasts llancen blocs de ferro i alliberen molta ferralla.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<red><bold>Wave %1:</bold></red> <white>%2 robots incoming.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<red><bold>Onada %1:</bold></red> <white>arriben %2 robots.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<green><bold>Wave %1 cleared!</bold></green> <yellow>Supplies are falling at the center. Wave resumes in %2 s.</yellow>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<green><bold>Onada %1 superada!</bold></green> <yellow>Cauen subministraments al centre. L'onada torna en %2 s.</yellow>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Taser</bold></aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Taser</bold></aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Right-click to connect nearby robots automatically.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Clic dret per connectar automàticament els robots propers.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>More charge supports more targets; it recharges while carried.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Més càrrega permet més objectius; es recarrega mentre el portes.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua>Taser L%1: %2/%3</aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua>Taser N%1: %2/%3</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<yellow>Taser L%1 active: %2/%3</yellow>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<yellow>Taser N%1 actiu: %2/%3</yellow>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Taser Core</bold></aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Nucli de Taser</bold></aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Pick up to upgrade your Taser's charge, chaining, and recharge.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Recull-lo per millorar la càrrega, els enllaços i la recàrrega del Taser.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Taser upgraded to level %1.</bold></aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Taser millorat al nivell %1.</bold></aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Your Taser is already fully upgraded.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>El teu Taser ja està millorat al màxim.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Place TNT, light it with flint and steel, then retreat! Unlit TNT is recoverable. Blasts hurt you and robots, break scaffolds and chain nearby TNT; scrap and teammates are safe.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Posa TNT, encén-la amb l'encenedor i allunya't! Pots recuperar-la apagada. L'explosió et fereix a tu i als robots, trenca bastides i encén TNT propera; respecta ferralla i companys.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Too much TNT deployed. Recover or detonate a charge first.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Hi ha massa TNT desplegada. Recupera o fes explotar una càrrega abans.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua>Sneak + jump to boost about 2 blocks up and 3 forward. Land and wait 8 seconds to reuse. A click and sparks mean ready.</aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua>Ajup-te i salta per impulsar-te uns 2 blocs amunt i 3 endavant. Aterra i espera 8 segons per repetir. Un clic i espurnes indiquen que està llest.</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>A Cutter spins up for 1.2 seconds before cutting scaffolds, then rests for 2 seconds. Stop it with your Taser or jump away!</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>El tallador prepara la serra durant 1,2 segons abans de tallar bastides i després descansa 2 segons. Atura'l amb el Taser o salta per fugir!</gold>
